overview_description.description:
Rulebase offers an online platform that enables individuals to find information about laws and rules. It enables its users to access federal, state, and local laws; and business, lifestyle, sports, and religious rules.

Rulebase was founded by David Pinkus in 1999 and is based in Dallas, Texas.
